title: Subpixel Geometric Reconstruction of a Cylindrical Candidate in Curiosity Mastcam-100 Imagery
description: November 13, 2026 manuscript revision, subtitled Boundary metrology, frozen-shape prediction, and geological comparison. Includes authentic PDS imagery, retained boundary measurements, frozen-shape and guarded coordinate predictions, geological straightness comparison, finite-boundary sensitivity, deterministic figure generation and provenance verification. Manufacturing-like geometric regularity motivates a manufacture hypothesis; complete shape, composition and origin remain unresolved. This local metadata describes the working manuscript and does not assign a new deposit DOI or publication date.
